registration.public.form.title: Join the Secret Santa
registration.public.form.intro: Three fields are enough. A verification code then arrives in your mailbox.
registration.public.form.shared_known: This address is already registered in the group.
registration.public.form.shared_hint: The code goes to this address. Tick the box if you share it with a parent, a child or your partner.
registration.public.form.privacy: Your address is only used to send you your link and your reminders.
registration.public.form.foot: This link is for the family only. The list of people who signed up stays private.
registration.public.code.title: Check your mail
registration.public.code.intro: A code has just been sent to your address. Type it below, or open the link in the same mail.
registration.public.code.label: {n}-character code
registration.public.code.nothing_text: Look in your spam folder. Otherwise, ask the organiser to validate you: they can open your access without a code, and your personal link is then sent to you right away.
registration.public.done.title: You are in!
registration.public.done.mail: Your personal link has been sent by mail.
registration.public.done.mail_note: Keep it: it is your key to come back.
registration.public.done.letter_text: Your giver will read your ideas in secret. The more precise they are, the more your gift will suit you.
registration.public.done.letter_note: Two minutes are enough. You can edit it until the big day.
registration.public.error.bad_request: This request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
